site.name: LearnViaNotes

signUp.lead: Free, and built for students. Your notes stay private until you choose otherwise.

signUp.institutionalHint: We send it a code to verify you. Without one, a teacher or our team can verify you later.
signUp.terms: I accept the Terms, the Privacy Policy and the licence for content I make public.

verify.resent: A new code is on its way.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a link.

reset.done: Your password is changed and every device was signed out. Sign in with the new one.

callback.failed: That sign-in could not be completed. Start again from the sign-in page.
